cells.title: Check chart, diagram, flow and motion artifacts in the design gate at 0.6.2
cells.action: RED FIRST: add the failing tests to the existing tests module of design_group.rs (fake node and fake cli, canned JSON per page) and watch each fail for its own reason, then change the code. (3) Per D6 detect artifacts: among the HTML pages the gate already scores, a page whose text contains data-chart-owned="true" also runs ui chart lint <page> --json, data-diagram-owned="true" runs ui diagram lint, an element whose class attribute has the token scrub runs ui tenant-lint; from the same walk (same skipped dirs, ignoring design.pages globs) a file named flow.json or ending in .flow.json runs ui flow lint. Read data.errorCount (required) and data.warningCount (missing counts as 0: tenant-lint returns none). A linter that does not start or returns other JSON is a failure line naming the kind and path, like the page case. (4) Per D7 the baseline gains an artifacts object keyed by kind (chart, diagram, motion, flow) then path, each {errors, warnings}; a known artifact may not gain errors; one with no entry must have 0 errors; regression lines read design gate: <kind> <path> — errors rose a -> b or design gate: <kind> <path> — new <kind> has n errors, must have 0. Per D12, when the baseline file exists but has no artifacts key, artifact errors are not failures: the advisory line also names the artifacts with errors.
